description: Six-storey Praya apartments with framed side bays, glazed rear circulation and planted shared loggias. Ten compact studios now include private bathrooms, kitchens, storage and living areas; the penthouse has separate sleeping and bathing spaces. September 9 successor: recessed glazing, projecting sills, connected thin blocks, framed signage and supported finishing details; original layout and identity retained.
